name: hopper-master

Retain EXACTLY SIX complete legs and SIX feet: a left and right FRONT pair, a left and right MIDDLE pair, and the two huge REAR jumping legs. Preserve all other proportions, color panels, empty saddle, antennae, camera, neutral pose and gray background. Do not add replacement legs. Count six feet before finishing. No text.
